title: CXWorks | Premium DCX Partner for eCommerce Brands
description: CXWorks helps eCommerce businesses improve customer experience, analytics, CRO, merchandising, and digital growth through one connected operating system.

blocks.a: Your website is your revenue engine.
blocks.b: We make every step of it work.
blocks.lead: Not a CRO agency. A DCX team for businesses with complex journeys, from first search to repeat order. Built for distributors, retailers and large-catalog brands.

small.l: Get enquiries online instead? See how we help

blocks.eb: Platforms and partners we work with

blocks.a: Your conversion rate is not the problem.
blocks.b: It is where the problem shows up.
lines: Buyers ask an AI tool and it recommends a competitor.
They land, search for a part number and get "no results".
They hesitate at shipping costs and pick up the phone instead.

blocks.h: Nine gates every customer passes through.
blocks.p: Lost revenue shows up at conversion, but it usually starts earlier. We find the earliest gate that fails and fix that first.
Every service sits under one of two stages, with an AI agent layer running across both.

items.name: Diagnose
items.line: Find the earliest failing gate before you spend on fixes.

items.name: Build
items.line: Fix the top issues in a 90-day sprint or a fixed-price job.

blocks.h: AI watches every gate. Experts decide and ship.

blocks.p: We fix templates, product data and search, not single pages. Change one product template or clean one attribute, and every page that uses it improves at once.

blocks.h: Whether customers buy from you online or enquire online, they can drop off at any step.

sell.eg: A distributor whose search shows "no results" for common part numbers.

enq.eg: A rehab centre whose admission form asks 20 questions before a call.
enq.fix: Shorter form, trust signals, call-back option.

blocks.h: Small enough to say yes to.
blocks.p: Each step sets up the next. Audits and fixed-price jobs sit beside the ladder as a side door, paid as you go or with prepaid credits.

items.d: Automated. Nine Gate score, catalog health snapshot, zero-result search sample and AI visibility check. AI does the work, a human adds a two-line note before it goes out.
Human-led. Finds the earliest failing gate and puts a money value on fixing it. Ends with a prioritised roadmap.
Fixes the top issues from the roadmap: templates, product data, search, tracking, first tests.

blocks.h: Named by the gate that was failing.

items.t: Part-number search that finally returns parts.
items.ch: Trade buyers typed exact part numbers and got "no results", so they picked up the phone instead.
items.ai: AI agents flagged 2,300 zero-result searches a month, most of them valid part numbers with formatting differences.
items.ex: Experts decided to fix the product data and search synonyms first, not the search UI.
items.quote: Our reps stopped being a search engine for our own website.

items.t: One template fix across 9,000 product pages.
items.ch: Shoppers could not filter by size or delivery date, then returned items that did not fit.
items.ai: AI flagged filter drop-off and return reasons clustering around dimensions.
items.ex: Experts rebuilt the listing and product templates once, so every page improved together.
items.quote: It felt like we fixed the whole site, not a page.

items.t: From a 20-question form to a call-back.
items.ch: The admission form asked 20 questions before anyone could talk to a person.
items.ai: AI flagged where families left the form and which pages built the most trust.
items.ex: Experts cut the form, added trust signals and a call-back option, within compliance rules.
items.quote: Families reach a person sooner, and that is the whole job.

blocks.h: Premium Digital Customer Experience Partner for eCommerce Brands
paras: CXWorks drives measurable eCommerce growth by aligning digital customer experience, analytics, merchandising, and acquisition into an integrated operating system.
CXWorks is a Digital Customer Experience and Growth partner for eCommerce brands across B2B, B2C, and D2C.

Modern eCommerce growth fails not because businesses lack technology, channels, or marketing investment. It fails because customer experience, analytics, merchandising, experimentation, AI search visibility, and growth marketing operate independently rather than as one connected system.

CXWorks helps B2B, B2C, and D2C eCommerce businesses identify where customer journeys break, prioritize the highest-impact improvements, and build measurable digital growth through one connected operating system.

blocks.p: Free AI scan. Nine Gate score in about 48 hours.
